overview: General info – Applicable to all types of leases (office, retail and or industrial). The lease commencement date is the date from which the lease commences. Scenarios 1: The Lease Commencement Date Can be fetched from Commencement Letter may be provided as an explicit date part of the lease agreement (either in the summary and or the body of the lease) or Formula based on may be a language OR May be a combination of both (i.e., language provided in the lease agreement and Lease Commencement Date (LCD)  /or Rent Commencement date (RCD) and the Term Ie. LED = LCD/RCD + term definition Scenarios 2: (Amendment available) – If an amendment is available, then the lease commencement date from the amendment should also be sourced Context: Abstraction of the below data fields from the perspective of an Originator or an Underwriter. Does the lease contain a Summary or Executive Summary or Basic Lease Provision or Fundamental Lease Provision or Basic Provision section referencing to the Summary Section Keywords Extract the full clauses that provide reference to the below: Commencement Date Lease Commencement Term begins Term Commencement Effective Date Lease begins Delivery date Possession date Definition of firm date: Explicit calendar date (e.g., January 1, 2025) Numeric date (01/01/2025) Caution: Ensure there are no strings prior or post the commencement date i.e. there should be no text or string pre or post the dates. If any sort of text exists like, anticipated to be or est, treat this to be a text and do not stop at this point. If the date is a text extract the descriptive details of the date and then go to QUESTION 4.Caution: Ensure there are no strings prior or post the commencement date i.e. there should be no text or string pre or post the dates. If any sort of text exists like, anticipated to be or est, treat this to be a text and do not stop at this point. If the date is a text extract the descriptive details of the date and then go to QUESTION 4. Examples: “Upon substantial completion” “Upon delivery of premises” 90 days after permit issuance Upon tenant occupancy Term section Definitions section Possession clause Delivery clause Examples: In no event later than Deemed to commence on Commencement date to be determined based xx% of occupancy Caution: Lease commencement date and Rent commencement date are not the same. Rent Commencement date is the date the tenant starts paying rent and the lease commencement date is the date the lease starts. Typically, the difference (if any in a situation where the two dates are defined) is considered to be free rent period.Caution: Lease commencement date and Rent commencement date are not the same.
